## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Sayings-Record of Chán Master Báiyún Shǒuduān* — a two-juan Northern-Sòng *yǔlù* of [Báiyún Shǒuduān](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%88%E7%AB%AF) 白雲守端 (1025–1072), the important Yángqí Línjì-sub-lineage master; dharma-heir of [Yángqí Fānghuì](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%B9%E6%9C%83) 楊岐方會 (992–1049) and teacher of [Wǔzǔ Fǎyǎn](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E6%BC%94) 五祖法演 (through whom the Yángqí line extends to [Yuánwù Kèqín](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%8B%E5%8B%A4) and beyond).

Two-juan Northern-Sòng Chán *yǔlù*, X69 n1351. Non-commentary; *commentedTextid* omitted.

Dating: *notBefore* c. 1060; *notAfter* c. 1100.
